In my current role as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I manage on-page SEO, write keyword-targeted content, and build and maintain WordPress sites. Best regards,

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am excited to apply for the Communications Specialist position at your company. With a strong foundation in digital marketing, content creation, and web management, I am confident in my ability to support your internal and external communications initiatives.

In my current role as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I have honed my skills in creating engaging content and managing online platforms. I am responsible for on-page SEO, writing keyword-targeted blog posts, and building and maintaining client websites using WordPress, Elementor, and the Astra theme. I regularly use Google Analytics, SEMrush, and Ahrefs to track performance and inform content strategies. My experience with Canva and AI-assisted tools has enabled me to produce visually appealing materials efficiently.

One of my proudest achievements is my project mirook.com, where I designed and built a multi-page WordPress site for a Belgian youth chess champion. I implemented structured data (JSON-LD schema) and optimized for both traditional and AI-powered search engines, demonstrating my ability to think strategically and execute with attention to detail.

I am a creative problem solver who enjoys multitasking without losing sight of the details. I have excellent writing and proofreading skills, and I am comfortable working with cross-functional teams. I am particularly interested in contributing to internal communications, employer branding, and social media presence, with a strong focus on LinkedIn.

I am eager to bring my project management skills and enthusiasm for communications to your team. I am based in Zwijndrecht, near Antwerp, and am available for interviews at your convenience. Thank you for considering my application.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
